mapper.update: MERGE INTO DIAGRAM d USING (SELECT #{group_num} AS group_num, #{title} AS title, #{diagram_data} AS diagram_data FROM DUAL) s ON (d.group_num = s.group_num) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET d.title = s.title, d.diagram_data = s.diagram_data, d.updated_at = sysdate WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (diagram_num, group_num, title, diagram_data, created_at) VALUES (diagram_seq.nextVAL, s.group_num, s.title, s.diagram_data, sysdate)
